content: Bowabow Kakafin Baitumatum Naatu Sinaf
Jesu ana bai’ufununayah iuwih eo, “Bowabow kakafin ana routobon i turobe boro hinamatar, baise orot yait iti sawar niwa’an hinamamatar boro yababan gagamin na’in nab.
Naatu orot yait nati na’atube nasisinaf, ana gewasin nati orot boro sikan aumor hina’utan taiy yan hinitaiy nare, men basit nama au kek gidigidih niwawa’anih bowabow kakafih hinasinaf.

Imih abisa kwasisinaf mata toniwa’an, taituwa baitumatumayan bowabow kakafin nasisinaf na’at, inakwarar tatab nihamiy, naatu bowabow kakafin nihamiyen dogoron nabikitabir na’at ana bowabow kakafih inanot tawiyen.

Naatu veya ta’imon wanawanan mar etei seven na’atube o isa nasisinaf kakaf isan, mar etei seven namatabir maiye nan biya natit nao. Ayu o isa bowabow kakafin asinaf, ana bowabow kakafih inanot tawiyen.
Baitumatum
Tur Abarayah Jesu isan hio, “Regah ai baitumatum kwira’at.”
Regah iyafutih eo, “Kwa a baitumatum ai momor ro’on na’atube, kwa boro iti ai uwa isan kwanao, ‘A wairoron etei ku’uy ra’ah kwen tor yan kure kubat,’ boro fana nab kwao na’atube nasinaf.
Akirwairafin Ana Bowabow
“Naatu itinin ta i iti na’atube, o ta a bowayan orot masaw tabowabow o sheep takakaifen rabirab au bar tanan, boro men ana merar itay naatu itau, ‘Kurun kumare bay ta ku’aan.’
Ai’abin, o boro mat a bay tabogaigiwas itaa, imaibo i tamare taa tatom.
Naatu a bowayan orot iyun sisinaf isan i boro men o ana merar yin isan tama takaifimih en.

Imih kwa auman ef i nati ta’imon, abisa bowamih hinao hiyuni kwa bowabow ufunamaim, kwa na’atumo kwanao, ‘It i akirwairafit wabit men gagamin aisim merarayow isan tananot, abisa hi’u’uwit na’atube tasinafuka.’”
Jesu Orot Ten Iyawasih
Jesu au Jerusalem yey ana veya i tafaram Samaria naatu Galilee hairi hai yoyow ana founamaim yen in.
Naatu na bar merar ta titit auman, orot nah etei 10 biyah kokom ani’anih bairi hitar. Ef yok na’in hibat
naatu hi’af hio, “Regah Jesu kwiwanbabani!”
Jesu nuw itih, basit iuwih eo, “Kwan firis biyan kwatit naatu biya enuteteyan itah.” Baise hitit efamaim hinan, biyah etei higewasin.
Naatu wanawanahimaim orot ta’imon biyan bigewasin itin, basit matabir maiye fanan sib God bora’ara’ah auman na.
Jesu nanamaim me yan ra’iy ana merar yi. Naatu iti orot i Samaria matuwan.
Naatu Jesu eo, “Orot nah etei i ten biyah higewasin, naatu orot nah nine i menamaim tema’am?
Aisim iti orot menan ta akisinamo na God ana merar eyiy?” Naatu Israel sabuw aisim boro men iti na’atube hitasinaf?
Imaibo Jesu orot iu eo, “Kumisir au bar kwen, a baitumatumamaim iyawas.”
God Ana Aiwob I Enan
Pharisee afa Jesu hibatiy hio, “God ana aiwob i boro mar biy nan?” Jesu iyafutih eo, “God ana aiwob i men bebeyanamaim enan,
boro sabuw hina’itin hinao, ‘Kwa’itin iban iti, o iban ni’i.’ Anayabin God ana aiwob i kwa wanawanamaim ema’am.”
Imaibo ana bai’ufununayah iuwih eo, “Mar enan kwa boro kwanakaibaban kwanao, ‘Orot Natun ana veya mi’itube tanan tata’itin,’ baise nati ana veya boro men kwana’itinimih.
Sabuw boro hina’uwi hinao, ‘I ban ni’i enan kwa’itin, o iti enan kwa’itin.’ Sabuw hinao men ufuh kwananunuwamih.
Anayabin Orot Natun namatabir maiye nanan ana veya, tafaram wanawanan ana’itin i boro namanamar ebow tafaram etei emamarakaw na’atube boro namarakaw.
Baise wantoro’ot i boro sabuw iyab iti boun tema’am ana veya’amaim boro hinab hini’a’akir, hinakwahir biyababan ta ta hinitin.
Ana itinin i boro Noah ana veya’amaim mamatar na’atube, Orot Natun ana veya’amaim boro na’atube namatar.
Noah ana veya’amaim sabuw hi’aa hitomatom, orot babin hitatabin, wanawanan Noah wa wanawanan run harew gagamin tit sabuw etei himorob.
Naatu ana itinin ta i Lot ana veya’amaim mamatar na’atube. Orot babin hi’aa hitom, masaw hitar hibow, bar hiwowab, hitobon hi’aa hinan wanawanan
Lot tafaram Sodom bihamiy ana veya wairaf marane God iyafar re sabuw etei e’arahih himorob.”
Ana itinin i ta’imon, Orot Natun nanan ana veya boro nati na’atube namatar.
Nati ana veya’amaim orot yait ana or ema’am boro men nayen bar ana sawar nabow, na’atube orot ana masaw ebow boro men namatabir bar sawar nabowamih.
Orot Lot aawan isan abisa namatar i kwananot!
Orot yait i taiyuwin ana yawas enunuwih boro men nabaimih, baise orot yait ana yawas ayu isou kwakwahir ana yawas boro natita’ur nab.
A tur ao’owen, nati ana guguminamaim, orot rou’ab boro gem ta’imon tafan hina inu’in, orot ta boro hina bora’ah, ta boro gem tafan hinihamiy na’in.
Baibin rou’ab boro hinama maiwok hinakakair, babin ta boro hina bora’ah ta boro hinihamiy nama.
Orot rou’ab boro hinama masaw hinabob, orot ta boro hina bora’ah, ta boro masaw yan hinihamiy nama.”
Ana bai’ufununayah hibatiy hio, “Regah iti boro menamaim namatar?” Jesu iyafutih eo, “Efan menamaim murumurubih biyah ti’inu’in mamu ikou boro imaim hinaru’ay.”
